senses.gloss:
डिम m. (-मः) A dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle
or seige, such as the Tripurabadha, in which the destruction of
the three cities of TRIPURA by ŚIVA is dramatised.
 E. डिम affray,
and affix क 2. One of the ten kinds of drama, thus defined:--मायेन्द्र-
जालसंग्रामक्रोधोद्भान्तादिचेष्टितैः । उपरागैश्च भूयिष्ठो डिमः ख्यातोऽतिवृत्तकः ॥

डिम्ब m. (-म्बः)
 1. Affray, assault. conflict without weapons mutual de-
fiance, petty and predatory war, &c. See डमर.
 2. Sound or noise
occasioned by terror.
 3. An egg.
 4. A chrysalis.
 5. The bladder.
6. The spleen.
 7. The uterus.
 8. Fear, terror.
 9. Any young ani-
mal.
 10. A globe or ball.
 E. डिबि घञ् अच् वा ।

डिम्बाहव m. (-वः) Petty warfare, affray. skirmish, riot, &c.
 E. डिम्ब
as above, and आहव war, battle; also डिम्बयुद्ध and other similar
compounds.

डिम्बिका f. (-का)
 1. A bubble.
 2. A kind of waterfly.
 3. A libidinous
woman.
 E. डिम्ब the bladder, &c. कन् aff, or डिवि-ण्वुल् ।

डिम्प्र m. (-म्भः)
 1. Any young animal.
 2. A fool, an idiot, a blockhead.
f. (-म्भा) An infant.
 E. डिभि to collect, affix अच्; कन् being added;
also डिम्भक.
डिम्भचक्र n. (-क्रं) A diagram for telling fortunes.
